subtitle: Clocks, signals and the edge of the sky
about:
A short guide to the one idea that underlies every map, clock and satellite: light takes time to arrive. In three chapters it follows a signal from a distant quasar to the phone in your pocket, and shows why a few billionths of a second matter.

Written for readers with no physics beyond school, it keeps the maths to a single equation and the wonder intact.

praise.quote: The clearest short account of why timing is everything.
A small book that makes the sky feel close.
